verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json), machine-readable docs mirrors, and MCP servers that can search and execute the Cloudflare API. None of it documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-the-browser examples. An OpenAPI file and an MCP execute tool are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
